description: Checks HTML, JSX, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Angular or Lit markup and CSS you wrote against the installed c2n API: native controls a c2-* element replaces (<button>, <input>, <select>, <textarea>, <dialog>, <details>, <progress>), unknown c2-* tags, attributes, slots, events and --c2-* variables (with "did you mean"), and box styling on a c2-* host. Lists the imports that register the elements used. Call it on every file you write before finishing.

code.description: The source to check: a component file, a template, a stylesheet or a snippet

filename.description: File name, which sets how the source is read (`App.tsx`: JSX props; `styles.css`: a stylesheet). Always pass it; without it the source is read as HTML

name: validate_markup
title: Validate markup
